_doc: THE SHIFT REGISTER (ARCH-COMPOSED-PROSE §8.6; lane SEAM car 4). EVERY MECHANISM WHOSE CHANGE RE-ROLLS A DRAWN INDEX, each with its PIN, its DOOR and its declared-row idiom. THE PROMISE (W3): a FACT shift is forbidden; a TEXT shift is declared and owner-signed. v1 of the architecture declared two shifts and carried at least three more undeclared, which is the failure this file exists to make impossible: a mechanism absent from this register is a same-seed text shift nobody signed. Consumed by tests/data/dossierStateProseProjection.contract.test.js, which PRINTS the register and RECOMPUTES every pin from the leaves themselves. Nothing reads this at runtime and nothing ships it.
_pinIdiom: A PIN IS A MEASUREMENT, NOT A PROMISE. Each row's `pin` is recomputed by the contract test from the committed leaves (`integer` and `map` compared directly, `digest` re-derived over the named material, `source` asserted as a substring of the named file), so a mechanism that moves without its row moving reds NAMING THE MECHANISM. A car that intends the move edits the row IN THE SAME COMMIT as the change and records the shift class; a car that did not intend it has just been told. This is the `.prose-byte-baseline.json` declared-row idiom applied to draw mechanisms instead of bytes.
_digestMaterial: Every `digest` pin is sha256 over one line per pool, the pools ordered by `${block} :: ${pool}` ascending, joined by a single newline with no trailing newline. The line is `${block} :: ${pool} :: ${value}` except for `pool-key-rename`, whose line is `${block} :: ${pool}` alone, and for `norm-bit`, whose line is `${blockId}::${poolKey} ${departure}` over the norm leaf's own rows in key order. A digest is used wherever the mechanism is per-pool: 708 integers cannot be read by a person, and a digest that moves names the mechanism while the diff names the pool.
_shiftClasses: ARCH §8.6 declares FOUR text-shift classes and nothing else re-rolls a drawn index: 1 the REWRITE + FACES freeze (car 8a-8n, one owner re-record); 2 the list-position keys (car 10); 3 THIN-pool growth (car 9b); 4 TURNS (car 11). Each row below names the class it would land under. A row whose `shift` is `none` names a mechanism that must NEVER move: a renumbering, and a pool-key rename.

reIndexed._doc: THE ONE-TIME RE-INDEX, DECLARED. This is the record §N.2 makes the owner's veto stand on: `the classifier prints RE-INDEXED per cell at Shift 1 and the owner's veto stands until that record is signed`. It cannot be a `pin`, because nothing here is recomputable from the leaves — it takes a DRIFT run at two shas — so it is a declared row that the contract test PRINTS and holds to its own arithmetic.

reIndexed.note: REPLACED 0 is the car's own fence, EXECUTED on every cell: not one changed POOL, so no fact moved. A cell is RE-INDEXED when the same pool's same eligible set yielded a different member, which is exactly what the draw rule changed and is the only thing it changed. WORDING-ONLY 0 and ADDITIVE 0 say the same from the other side: no sentence was rewritten and no piece was added by this car.

measured._doc: THE DISTRIBUTION TABLE ruling (c) asks the sitting for. It cannot be read on the SHIPPED corpus and the reason is pinned two rows below: `attach-set` is 0, so no unit has a modifier and no unit has a shape question. The figures here are the script DRIVEN on the taste's committed dock (laneTASTE f07b98529, read-only history), which is the only corpus carrying attach rows at this date. 8b re-runs it on the defense section and the sitting rules there.
measured.corpus: laneTASTE @ f07b98529 — 7 attach-bearing pools, 408 composable units, 64 fixed seeds, 26,112 draws
measured.reading: SHAPE 1's MARGINAL DOMINANCE IS NOT A TIC, which is the exact discrimination ruling (c) was written to make. Conditional on both shapes being lawful the draw splits 48.58 / 51.42 per cent, so shape 1 leads the marginal only because it is the sole lawful shape on 21,824 of 26,112 draws. 341 of the 408 units refuse shape 2 for want of a noun carried into the spine, so the thread rule is the binding constraint and not the draw.
measured.note: The duplicate-unit rate moves 26 basis points, which is small and is reported as small: shape variation is not a lever on repetition at this sample, and ruling (c) pairs the two columns precisely so a small movement there cannot be sold as a large one.

mechanisms.note: ⭐⭐ RE-POINTED AT CAR 8b-W-18o (ADDENDUM 18 rulings 29 and 40). This row was the estate's only instrument for SENTENCE SHAPE, and it measures the ARRANGEMENT of a spine against its modifiers — which is inert, because `attach-set` is 0 and no shipped unit has a modifier. Ruling 29 asked for variety in how a sentence OPENS, which this row cannot see at all. That variety now has its own mechanism and its own row: `openerClassOf` in the kernel (seven closed classes, computed at render) and the `opener-adjacency` row below, which is the thing that actually re-rolls a draw. ⛔ AND RULING 40 (the owner, 2026-09-13 ~13:3x) STRUCK THE OTHER HALF OF RULING 29 BEFORE IT LANDED: there is no `SURVEY_FRAMES` table and no `{survey}` slot anywhere, so no row here points at one and none should be added. This row keeps its own pins and its own arrangement question, unchanged.

mechanisms.mechanism: the wording-face draw: its key — a SUFFIX of the variant key, so the parent string never changes — and, since REWRITE car 8b-W-18c, its ELIGIBLE SET AND MODULUS. The digest of `${seed}::${blockId}::${poolKey}::w` is taken modulo the number of faces whose SOURCE resolves on THIS TOWN and indexes the ascending eligible list (kernel `eligibleFaces` → `drawFace`): a face with no source or the universal `stranger` is eligible everywhere, a face tagged `hall` only where a hall stands (`faceSources.js` `sourcesOf`, the desks' `withFaceSources`); no roster reads as the stranger alone; none eligible falls back to the full set. A face carrying a PAIR mark draws its partner beside it where the partner also resolves (composer `drawPiece` → kernel `facePartner`), the partner's piece marked `pairOf` with the pair's `pairKind`. Since REWRITE car 8b-W-18i the eligible set also EXCLUDES the `archiver` face outright (ADDENDUM 18 ruling 22): the thirteenth word of `FACE_SOURCES` is not a power of the town but the hand the page is written in, and its row reaches the page only through `faceWeigh`, beside the pair it closes — so the draw can never land on it and `facePartner` can never return it
mechanisms.shift: 1 — the faces land with the rewrite. ⭐ 8b-W-18c: the face draw filters by source (ADDENDUM 18 ruling 15) — a declared text shift inside the REWRITE + FACES freeze. On a variant carrying a sourced face, the same seed and the same eligible SET can yield a different face than the unfiltered modulus would (the modulus is the eligible count, not the face count), and two towns on one seed hear different powers — which is the ruling's own aim (organic variance). ZERO MOVED TODAY, measured and not argued: no shipped variant carries a `sources` list, so every face is the stranger's, the eligible list is the identity `[0..n-1]`, `eligible[h % n]` is `h % n`, and every one of the 2,266 variants still returns before the hash pair runs (one face eligible). The six leaves' bytes are unchanged by this car and the kernel's sweep asserts the no-hash path over the live corpus

mechanisms.note: ⭐ 8b-W-18m (ADDENDUM 18 ruling 26): the composer's ONE call site is now `compromisedFace`, which is `drawFace` on every pool no covert field marks and the COMPROMISED path on the one or two it does — so BOTH spellings are pinned below and a car that dropped either reds here by name. 8b-W-18c: the face draw filters by source (ADDENDUM 18 ruling 15) — a declared text shift inside the REWRITE + FACES freeze. The first pin below is the car-3a key, unchanged; the next three are the filter, the fallback and the modulus, so a car that widened the eligible set back to every face, or dropped the fallback, reds here by name; the last is the pair draw's one call site. ⭐ 8b-W-18i added the archiver's exclusion and the weighing row's one call site; ZERO MOVED, because no shipped variant carries an archiver face and the exclusion is a `continue` ABOVE the pinned filter line. ⭐⭐ 8b-W-18n RE-CUT TWO OF THESE PINNED LINES AND MOVED NOTHING, which is the only reason they could be re-frozen rather than argued with (ADDENDUM 18 rulings 27 and 28). (1) The universal test widened from `source === UNIVERSAL_SOURCE` to `UNIVERSAL_SOURCES.includes(source)`, because the PUBLIC is a second source seated by nothing and therefore seated everywhere; on the shipped corpus no variant carries a `public` face, so the predicate answers identically on every one of the 2,266. (2) The archiver's `continue` became a branch that admits the face when it is marked `observed` (ruling 27, the one archiver row that draws alone); on the shipped corpus no variant carries an `observed` list at all, so `faceIsObserved` is false everywhere and the branch is the old `continue` byte for byte. Both new pins name the NEW line, so a car that widened either back reds here.

mechanisms.mechanism: THE ATTRIBUTION ROLE DRAW (ADDENDUM 18 ruling 25, the owner's; car 8b-W-18l). The page prints a ROLE, never an institution: a `{hall}` slot on a face is replaced at render by a person drawn from the TOWN'S OWN institution rows (`institutionRoles.js` through `faceSources.js` `rolesOf`), on the key `${seed}::${blockId}::${poolKey}::r${face}::${source}::${offset}` — a suffix of the variant key carrying the FACE INDEX and the SLOT'S CHARACTER OFFSET, so a face naming two sources draws two different people on one seed and the variant and face draws above are untouched. The candidate list is the source's roster MINUS every role already printed ON THIS PAGE, and an exhausted roster repeats rather than silencing the face. ⛔ IT WAS ABSENT FROM THIS REGISTER UNTIL CAR 8b-W-18o-r, which is the defect this row cures: a mechanism absent from the register is a same-seed text shift nobody signed, and this one re-rolls a PERSON'S NAME on every face that carries a slot.
mechanisms.shift: 1 — the REWRITE + FACES freeze. The roster is a fact about the TOWN, so a car that adds a catalogue row to `INSTITUTION_ROLES`, or that changes which rows a source lends, re-rolls every role that source prints on every town holding that row — the modulus is the roster's length. ⭐ AND THE PAGE'S EXCLUSION SET IS PART OF THE MECHANISM (car 8b-W-18o-r): a role commits to that set only WHEN ITS PIECE LANDS, so a dropped piece consumes nothing; before that car a dropped piece consumed a person and the next face on the page drew somebody else because of a sentence the reader never saw.

mechanisms.idiom: a row added to the role table is a declared car on THIS row, because the modulus of every source that row lends moves. A role is never DELETED (the same NEVER TRIM rule the pools keep); a fallback roster is the floor and is never lowered.

mechanisms.mechanism: THE OPENER PREFERENCE (ADDENDUM 18 rulings 29 (II) and 36, the owner's; car 8b-W-18o, threaded at 8b-W-18o-r). Before the face modulus runs, the eligible list is narrowed to the faces whose OPENER CLASS differs from the last unit drawn ON THIS PAGE (`openerClassOf` in the kernel: attributed · place · time · fronted · expletive · entry · subject). The KEY IS UNCHANGED — `${seed}::${blockId}::${poolKey}::w`, the same suffix `drawFace` has always used — so what moves is the MODULUS AND THE LIST, never the digest. A PREFERENCE AND NEVER A BAN (ruling 36: "the draw's preference … never on every repeat; no exemplar's same-opener rate is zero"): where narrowing would empty the list, or would change nothing, `preferOpener` answers `null` and the draw is `drawFace` itself, byte for byte.
mechanisms.shift: 1 — the REWRITE + FACES freeze. ⭐ DECLARED AND MEASURED AT CAR 8b-W-18o-r, the car that THREADS the page state and therefore the car that lights this. At 8b-W-18o the mechanism landed INERT (nothing passed `drawnOpeners`, so the previous class was always null and the preference always answered null; the 40-town page render hashed identically on both sides). At 8b-W-18o-r the Defense tab began handing ONE read to all seven of its desk entries, the trail became the page's, and the preference started biting. MEASURED over the first 250 rate-grid towns: the pool `DS-DEF-2 :: Invasion & War: walls with NO force` is drawn 31 times and 7 of those draws MOVE (22.6 per cent). The face distribution moves 8/9/8/6 → 4/12/8/7 — AWAY from face 0, which is the spine and opens on the SUBJECT, and that is the ruling working rather than a defect: the previous unit on the page also opened on the subject, so the page stops opening two units running the same way. NOTHING ELSE IN THE CORPUS MOVES, because 707 of the 708 pools carry one face per variant and a list of one cannot narrow.
mechanisms.door: src/domain/display/stateProse/stateProseKernel.js `openerClassOf` and `OPENER_CLASSES` (the classifier, closed and asserted TOTAL at projection); src/domain/display/stateProse/composeStateProse.js `preferOpener` and the `drawnOpeners` trail; src/domain/display/stateProse/faceSources.js `pageProse` (the page's one read). The projector asserts the classifier is total over every face it projects, so a face that could not be classified is a refusal at generation rather than a silent `subject`.
mechanisms.idiom: a car that changes the CLASSIFIER changes this row, because a face that re-classifies re-rolls every page whose previous unit shared its old class. The classes are CLOSED at seven and a new one is a declared car. ⛔ THE PREFERENCE MAY NEVER BECOME A BAN: a narrowing that empties the list must answer `null` and never silence a rung — ruling 36 is explicit, and kernel law 1 says the same thing in the other direction.

mechanisms.mechanism: THE COMPROMISED SOURCE'S SPEAKS-OR-SILENT ROLL (ADDENDUM 18 ruling 26, the owner's; car 8b-W-18m). On a pool whose SYMPTOM a covert field marks, a roll seeded on `${seed}::${poolKey}::${settlementId}::${year}::compromised` decides whether the compromised source speaks (and is FORCED into the unit with its concealing candidate preferred) or says nothing (and is dropped from the draw). The share is `COMPROMISED_SPEAKS`, 0.7, compared against the uint32 digest's position in its range rather than a modulus, so the rate is exact to one part in 2^32.
mechanisms.shift: 1 — the REWRITE + FACES freeze. ⛔⛔ AND THIS ROW CARRIES THE FLAG THE REGISTER DID NOT HAVE A PLACE FOR UNTIL NOW: **`year` IS THE FIRST DRAW INPUT IN THE WHOLE DOSSIER BEYOND THE SEED AND A POOL'S IDENTITY.** Every other mechanism in this file keys on (seed, blockId, poolKey) and a suffix; this one also keys on the SETTLEMENT and on TIME. That is a change in kind, not in degree, and the principle that bounds it is written beside the function and asserted by a test: A YEAR-SEEDED ROLL DECIDES WHO SPEAKS, NEVER WHAT IS TRUE. It chooses between two lawful pages and can make no false sentence true. THE PROMISE holds — same seed, same year, same page — because the year is an INPUT and not a clock: `renderYearOf` reads `history.age`, which advances when the world advances and is constant on a re-read.
